title: One Man Down
summary: The player killed one of Varn's men; Varn decides whether the cart comes early, late or on the night.

hooks.situation: One of yours is dead, and the word is {player} {event.summary}. The valley will have heard by now, and a valley that learns a Hollow man can die starts thinking.

options.label: Bring the cart early; show them one dead man changed nothing

effects.reason: Varn brought the cart a night early, to show the valley one dead man changed nothing.

options.label: Hold the cart a night; see who stands at the gate first

effects.reason: The cart came a night late. Varn wanted to see who was standing at the gate before he came to it.

effects.text: Find {player} on the road and ask, pleasantly, how many friends they have in Thornhaven.

options.label: Keep the night, and let the stranger know you know

effects.text: Tell {player}, pleasantly, the dead man's name, and that you will remember theirs.

options.label: Keep the night as it is; a perfect collection answers everything
